name: Wall Heel Slide
steps: Lie on your back with your glutes near a wall and legs resting vertically up against the wall.
Slowly slide the heel of your target leg downward along the wall, bending your knee as far as comfortably tolerated.
Let gravity assist the gentle bending of your knee into a pain-free stretch.
Pause at your maximum comfortable bend for 2 to 3 seconds.
Contract your quad and slide your heel back up the wall to the straight-leg starting position.
coaching_cues: Wear a sock or place a small towel under your heel so it glides smoothly on the wall.
You can use your opposite foot to lightly support or guide the target foot if needed.
Never force into sharp joint pain; allow gentle progressive stretching.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Range of Motion Protocol
